summary: Verified Facebook Pixel + Conversions API dual tracking on /lubov-bez-bolka. All 3 backend endpoints return events_received:1 from Facebook. Browser Pixel loads and initializes with correct ID (1326425393018449). CTA click fires both window.fbq and POST /api/facebook/track-event with _fbp cookie and event_id for deduplication.
passed: Meta Pixel script (fbevents.js) loads on page; window.fbq is a function with loaded=true, version 2.9.347
Console: 'Meta Pixel initialized: 1326425393018449' logged on page mount
CTA click ('Искам достъп') dispatches BOTH window.fbq('track','checkout_cta_click',...) AND POST /api/facebook/track-event
Server-side payload includes fbp cookie (fb.1.<ts>.<id>) extracted from document.cookie and event_id for Pixel/CAPI deduplication
Console shows '✅ Server-side event sent: checkout_cta_click' confirming dual-track success
Backend correctly captures client IP and User-Agent from request (per facebook_tracking.py)

failed.issue: Facebook warns 'Duplicate Pixel ID: 1326425393018449' – Pixel initialized twice due to React StrictMode double-invoking useEffect in dev.
failed.evidence: Browser console: 'warning: [Meta Pixel] - Duplicate Pixel ID: 1326425393018449.' and 'Meta Pixel initialized' logged twice.

failed.issue: Custom event 'checkout_cta_click' is sent via fbq('track', ...) instead of fbq('trackCustom', ...). Facebook logs warning that non-standard events should use trackCustom.
failed.evidence: Console: '[Meta Pixel] - You are sending a non-standard event checkout_cta_click. The preferred way ... is using trackCustom.'

action_items: (Optional) Guard Pixel init with a module-level flag or check window.fbq before re-initializing to eliminate 'Duplicate Pixel ID' warning under StrictMode.

(Optional) In utils/tracking.js trackEvent, use window.fbq('trackCustom', eventName, ...) for non-standard events like 'checkout_cta_click' and reserve 'track' for standard events (PageView, Lead, ViewContent, Purchase, etc.).
